scenario_meta.description: A cliffside city taxes spoken promises by their weight, and couriers carry unpaid ones between households.
scenario_meta.simulation_objective: Balance the city's linguistic economy without triggering a total collapse of trust.
player_entry_points: A new courier arriving at The Silent Runners Dispatch seeking their first route.
A debtor entering The Voiceless Refusal Hall to challenge their seizure notice.
An alchemist apprentice finding a discarded, unsealed promise in the streets.
A recruit reporting for duty at The Silence Keepers Barracks.
creator_conflict_hooks: The Scales of Oaths has suddenly increased the tax rate on all promises, causing a surge in defaults.
A shipment of high-weight promises has gone missing, and the Silence Keepers are blaming the couriers.
The Voiceless have begun a silent protest, refusing to speak any new promises, causing the market to freeze.
